'''Team Bantha''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] military unit during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the [[Mission to Sunfall Peak]], it created a diversion at an [[Imperial administration center]]. [[Ryenne]] then stole a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and Team Bantha rendezvoused with [[Team Thumper]].<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
